definition: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

amharic: የአካል ብቃት (ጤናማና ጠንካራ የመሆን አካላዊ ሁኔታ)

definition: A mathematical relationship or rule expressed in symbols.
example: Use the geometric formula to calculate the exact area of the triangle.
amharic: ቀመር | ፎርሙላ (በሳይንስ ወይም በሂሳብ ችግርን ለመፍታት የሚያገለግል ህግ)

definition: An unfair or invalid stroke or piece of play, especially one involving physical contact.

definition: A numerical quantity that is not a whole number (e.g. 1/2, 0.5).

amharic: ክፍልፋይ (የአንድ ሙሉ ነገር የተከፈለ ክፍል፤ በሂሳብ ስሌት)

definition: The cracking or breaking of a hard object or material, especially a bone.

amharic: የአጥንት ስብራት (በአደጋ ምክንያት አጥንት መሰበር)

example: Sunlight brought out small golden freckles across her nose and cheeks.
amharic: የፊት ነጠብጣብ / ጠቃጠቆ (በፀሐይ ምክንያት በቆዳ ላይ የሚወጣ ቡናማ ነጥብ)

definition: A refrigerated cabinet or room for preserving food at very low temperatures.
example: Keep frozen berries and meat securely sealed inside the deep freezer.
amharic: በረዶ ማቀዝቀዣ (ምግቦችን በረዶ አድርጎ እንዳይበላሹ የሚያቆይ ማቀዝቀዣ)

definition: A line or border separating two countries; an extreme limit of settled land.
example: Early explorers mapped uncharted mountainous frontier trails.
amharic: ድንበር | አዲስ መስክ (የአገር ወሰን፤ ወይም ያልተመረመረ አዲስ የሳይንስ መስክ)

amharic: ብስጭት (ያሰቡት ሳይሳካ ሲቀር የሚሰማ የቁጭት ስሜት)

definition: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.
example: The university established a scholarship fund for underprivileged youth.
amharic: ፈንድ | የገንዘብ ድጋፍ (ለአንድ ልዩ ተግባር የተመደበ ገንዘብ)

definition: Wild or violent anger.
example: The destructive fury of the ocean tempest battered the coastal pier.
amharic: ከፍተኛ ቁጣ (እጅግ በጣም የበረታ ንዴት)

definition: A small mechanical or electronic device or tool, especially an ingenious or novel one.
example: He bought a compact digital kitchen gadget that measures nutritional values.
amharic: አነስተኛ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መገልገያ (ጠቃሚ ተግባር የሚያከናውን አነስተኛ መሳሪያ)

definition: All of the people born and living at about the same time, regarded collectively.
example: The older generation transmitted ancestral farming techniques to their children.
amharic: ትውልድ (በአንድ ዘመን የተወለዱና አብረው የሚኖሩ ሰዎች)

definition: The quality of being kind and generous.
example: Neighbors appreciated her spontaneous generosity during the food drive.
amharic: ለጋስነት | ቸርነት (ያለ ስስት ለሌሎች የመስጠት መልካም ባህሪ)

definition: Exceptional intellectual or creative power or other natural ability.
example: Albert Einstein is universally celebrated as a scientific genius.
amharic: ሊቅ | ድንቅ አእምሮ ያለው (በጣም የላቀ የማሰብና የፈጠራ ችሎታ ያለው ሰው)

definition: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity.
example: Physical geography examines mountain ranges, oceans, and river valleys.
amharic: የመሬት አቀማመጥ ጥናት / ጂኦግራፊ (የምድርን ገጽታና የአየር ሁኔታ የሚያጠና ሳይንስ)

definition: A movement of part of the body, especially a hand or the head, to express an idea or meaning.
example: A warm welcoming wave of the hand is a universal friendly gesture.
amharic: የእጅ ወይም የፊት ምልክት (ሀሳብን ለመግለጽ የሚደረግ የአካል እንቅስቃሴ)

amharic: የዓለም ሙቀት መጨመር (በካይ ጋዞች የምድርን ሙቀት እንዲጨምር ማድረጋቸው)

definition: A person who plays golf, especially professionally.
example: The professional golfer sank a difficult twenty-foot birdie putt.
amharic: ጎልፍ ተጫዋች (በጎልፍ ስፖርት የሚወዳደር ሰው)

definition: The receiving or conferring of an academic degree or diploma.
example: Her entire extended family gathered for her university graduation.
amharic: ምረቃ (የትምህርት ደረጃን አጠናቆ ዲግሪ የመቀበል በዓል)

definition: Wheat or any other cultivated cereal crop used as food.
example: Silos store tons of dry grain for emergency regional bread production.
amharic: እህል (ስንዴ፣ ገብስና ጤፍን የመሳሰሉ የሰብል ፍሬዎች)

definition: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation.
example: He expressed sincere gratitude to the surgeon who saved his vision.
amharic: ምስጋና | ውለታ ማወቅ (ስለተደረገ መልካም ነገር የሚሰማ ልባዊ ምስጋና)

definition: A gas that contributes to the greenhouse effect by absorbing infrared radiation, e.g., carbon dioxide.
example: Methane and carbon dioxide are potent greenhouse gases driving climatic shifts.
amharic: ግሪንሃውስ ጋዝ (የፀሐይን ሙቀት በመያዝ የምድርን ሙቀት የሚጨምር ጋዝ)

definition: A book of information about a place, designed for the use of visitors or tourists.
example: The detailed guidebook highlighted scenic mountain trails and traditional eateries.
amharic: የጉዞ መመሪያ መጽሐፍ (ለቱሪስቶች ስለ አካባቢው መረጃ የሚሰጥ መጽሐፍ)

definition: A general rule, principle, or piece of advice.
example: Health authorities published dietary guidelines for schoolchildren.
amharic: መመሪያ (አንድን ስራ በትክክል ለመስራት የሚሰጥ አቅጣጫ)

definition: A hall or building equipped for gymnastics, basketball, and other physical exercise.
example: Students gather inside the high school gymnasium for winter volleyball drills.
amharic: የስፖርት ማዘውተሪያ አዳራሽ / ጂም (የአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ የሚሰራበት አዳራሽ)

definition: Exercises developing or displaying physical agility and coordination.
example: Gymnastics requires remarkable flexibility, upper body strength, and balance.
amharic: ጅምናስቲክስ (ሰውነትን በማጠፍና በመለጠጥ የሚደረግ የስፖርት ውድድር)

definition: The natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism.
example: The coastal mangrove swamp is the natural breeding habitat of sea turtles.
amharic: የተፈጥሮ መኖሪያ (እንስሳትና እጽዋት በተፈጥሮ የሚኖሩበት አካባቢ)

definition: An interior passage in a building connecting rooms.
example: Leave your wet umbrella and muddy boots in the entryway hallway.
amharic: መተላለፊያ ኮሪደር (በቤት ውስጥ ክፍሎችን የሚያገናኝ ረጅም መንገድ)

definition: A tool with a heavy metal head mounted at right angles at the end of a handle, used for pounding.
example: He used a steel claw hammer to drive the nail firmly into the wooden beam.
amharic: መዶሻ (ምስማር ለመምታት ወይም ነገር ለመስበር የሚያገለግል መሳሪያ)

definition: A rail fixed to posts or a wall for people to hold on to for support.
example: Grasp the sturdy wooden handrail when descending steep stone steps.
amharic: የደረጃ መደገፊያ (ደረጃ ሲወጡ ወይም ሲወርዱ በእጅ የሚደገፉበት ብረት/እንጨት)

example: The building handyman fixed the sticking door and replaced burned-out bulbs.

definition: A place on the coast where vessels may find shelter, especially one protected from rough water.
example: Fishing trawlers anchored securely inside the sheltered stone harbor.
amharic: የመርከብ ወደብ (መርከቦች የሚቆሙበትና የሚጠለሉበት የባህር ዳርቻ)

definition: The machines, wiring, and other physical components of a computer or other electronic system.
example: Upgrading computer hardware enhances processing speed and storage capacity.
amharic: ሃርድዌር / ብረታ ብረት (የኮምፒውተር አካላዊ ክፍሎች፤ ወይም የግንባታ እቃዎች)

definition: The combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce chords with a pleasing effect.
example: The choral choir sang in four-part vocal harmony.
amharic: ስምምነት | ቅንጅት (በሰዎች መሀል ያለ ሰላማዊ ግንኙነት፤ ወይም የሙዚቃ ውህደት)

definition: The process or period of gathering in crops.
example: Farmers worked together to gather the autumn barley harvest before the frost.
amharic: ምርት መሰብሰብ (የደረሰን ሰብል ከእርሻ ላይ የመሰብሰብ ስራ)

definition: A heading at the top of an article or page in a newspaper or magazine.
example: The morning newspaper's front-page headline announced the treaty.

example: The humanitarian agency established its international headquarters in Geneva.
synonyms: main office | base | command center | HQ
amharic: ዋና መስሪያ ቤት (የአንድ ድርጅት ወይም ወታደራዊ ክፍል ዋና ማዕከል)

definition: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room.
example: A woven fire rug lay safely before the stone fireplace hearth.
amharic: የምድጃ ወለል (የማሞቂያ እሳት የሚነድድበት የቤት ክፍል)

definition: An animal that feeds on plants.
example: Zebras and cattle are grazing herbivores that thrive on savannah grasses.
amharic: ዕፅዋት በል እንስሳ (ሳርና ቅጠል ብቻ የሚመገብ እንስሳ)

definition: A large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together or are kept together.
example: The shepherd guided the herd of goats toward the mountain stream.
amharic: የከብቶች መንጋ (አብረው የሚሰማሩ የላሞች ወይም የፈረሶች ስብስብ)

definition: Property that is or may be inherited; valued objects and qualities such as historic buildings.
example: Preserving traditional folk music safeguards our cultural heritage.
amharic: ቅርስ (ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ የሚተላለፍ ታሪካዊና ባህላዊ ሀብት)

definition: A beehive; a structure in which bees are kept, typically in the form of a dome.
example: Beekeepers inspected the cedar wood hive for honeycombs.
amharic: የንብ ቀፎ (ንቦች ማር የሚያመርቱበትና የሚኖሩበት ቀፎ)

definition: The quality of being honest; truthfulness.
example: Honesty and mutual respect form the foundation of enduring friendship.
amharic: ሐቀኝነት | ታማኝነት (እውነትን ብቻ የመናገር መልካም ባህሪ)

definition: A structure of hexagonal cells of wax, made by bees to store honey and eggs.
example: Fresh golden honey dripped from the chambers of the natural honeycomb.
amharic: የማር እንጀራ (ንቦች በሰም የሚሰሩት ባለ ስድስት ጎን የማር ማከማቻ)

definition: A right that is believed to belong justifiably to every person.
example: The international treaty protects universal human rights, dignity, and speech.
synonyms: civil liberties | natural rights | fundamental freedoms
amharic: ሰብአዊ መብቶች (ማንኛውም ሰው በተፈጥሮው ሊያገኛቸው የሚገቡ መሰረታዊ መብቶች)

definition: A modest or low view of one's own importance; humbleness.
example: Great leaders listen to counsel with genuine patience and humility.
amharic: ትህትና (ራስን ዝቅ የማድረግና ሌላውን የማክበር ባህሪ)

definition: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.
example: A healthy sense of humor helps people manage daily work stress.
amharic: ቀልድ | ጨዋታ (ሰውን የሚያስቅና የሚያዝናና ባህሪ)

definition: Conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease, especially through cleanliness.
example: Personal hygiene includes frequent handwashing and brushing teeth.
amharic: የግልና የአካባቢ ንጽህና (ጤናን ለመጠበቅ የሚደረግ የንጽህና አጠባበቅ)

definition: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
example: Researchers tested the hypothesis through controlled laboratory experiments.
amharic: የመላምት ሀሳብ (በምርምር ገና ያልተረጋገጠ ሳይንሳዊ መላምት)

definition: The ability of an organism to resist a particular infection or toxin.
example: Nutritious diets and adequate sleep strengthen human cellular immunity.
amharic: የበሽታ መከላከያ አቅም (የሰውነት በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋስያንን የመዋጋት አቅም)

definition: The action of one object coming forcibly into contact with another, or a marked effect.
example: Clean solar energy has a profound positive impact on rural communities.
amharic: ተጽዕኖ | ተጽዕኖ ማሳደር (የአንድ ክስተት በሌላው ላይ የሚያመጣው ጠንካራ ውጤት)
